verdict.rationale: Stripe's dispute docs describe Dashboard-guided responses and Smart Disputes, which automates evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes. That partially covers the evidence-response half of the story. Generic webhooks and the MCP server exist, but nothing ties them to dispute deadlines, and Smart Disputes auto-submits rather than drafting for human review. Missing for 10: documented dispute deadline fields or dispute-specific webhook events, an agent-driven draft-for-review workflow, Terminal-specific dispute handling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review

citations.quote: Use Smart Disputes to automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes.
After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
